description: The CSV package describes roadworks, closures, lane narrowing and other traffic restrictions using unique identifiers, impact levels, street locations, temporal windows and geographic geometry. The project catalogue explicitly relates it to context-aware mobility analysis. Native date metadata state 2018/2019 while the catalogue lists 2018–2022; the precise included interval is unresolved. These records represent historical reported constraints, without a claim that restrictions remain active or that every street intervention is covered. The source schema includes creation dates as distinct from restriction periods. Coverage is limited to the source-described systems and experiments. The related Zenodo deposit provides descriptive metadata, with open document or data access and licence label cc-by-4.0. Document rights do not establish software rights or access to the underlying observations. Only full descriptive metadata, file inventories and the project metadata catalogue were reviewed; no underlying measurements, code, paper or model archive was opened.
